findings.problem: The hint does not rule out other common ways to say 'former': the prefix ex- (mi exjefe) is very common in Latin America, and anterior (mi anterior jefe) also works before the noun.
findings.fix: hint: an adjective placed before the noun, as in my former boss; not the prefix ex- and not anterior

back.es: former, previous (before a noun); old, ancient (after a noun)
back.example: I saw my former boss at the market.

note: The point about word order is worth keeping: antiguo before the noun means former, and after the noun it means old, which keeps this card apart from the "ancient" card.
